instructions: Only a game-specific official team announcement explicitly naming the starter may be entered as CONFIRMED_STARTER. Required: team, gameId, starter, status CONFIRMED_STARTER, sourceType TEAM_ANNOUNCEMENT, source HTTPS URL, asOf timezone-aware pre-kickoff ISO timestamp within 7 days, reviewed true, and evidenceText quoting/paraphrasing the actual announcement. Official inactives alone establish unavailability, not the replacement starter. Previous-game primary passer and depth chart are never confirmation. No invented entries.
